title: Laser Tube Runtime Maintenance Window
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=laserweb:job
| stats latest(tube_hours) as tube_hours by cutter
| where tube_hours>900
| sort - tube_hours
description: Uses Laser cutter maintenance telemetry telemetry to monitor tube runtime against the replacement or inspection window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for lasers approaching maintenance thresholds, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Laser cutter maintenance telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Cutter table of accumulated tube hours.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors tube runtime against the replacement or inspection window so you can spot lasers approaching maintenance thresholds before it becomes annoying.
